task.description: The address of the task to review, for example @v1/nuucognition/task/<id>#ops. Usually the task has a result from do_task, with the commits and the session of the work.

next.interactive: Read {{task}} with ops task show --json, and its task note. Stop when the Session of the result, or the Orbh-Session trailer of a commit that the result names, is this session: a session does not review its own work. Add the task as an object with flint orbh objects add {{task}} --subscribe, check each item of the definition of done against reality, and give the findings to the person.
next.headless: Set the phase reviewing. Read {{task}} with ops task show --json, and its task note. Stop when the Session of the result, or the Orbh-Session trailer of a commit that the result names, is this session. Add the task as an object with flint orbh objects add {{task}} --subscribe, and check each item of the definition of done against reality. Keep the findings for the body and the result.

next.interactive: Fix each failed item that is straightforward, and commit it with the WIP commit rule. Keep each commit for the verdict. Flag each other item to the person.
next.headless: Set the phase resolving. Fix each failed item that is straightforward, and commit it with the WIP commit rule. Keep each commit for the verdict. Use a deferred request for a decision that you cannot make.

next.interactive: Pass: add the verdict and the review commits to the result with ops task result {{task}}, and keep the text of before. Fail: write the findings under Review Findings in the task note, and add the verdict to the result. Do not close the task. Run flint shard task task-sync {{task}}. Then close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done.
next.headless: Pass: add the verdict and the review commits to the result with ops task result {{task}}, and keep the text of before. Fail: write the findings under Review Findings in the task note, and add the verdict to the result. Do not close the task. Run flint shard task task-sync {{task}}. Close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done. When no parent frame is open, return with flint orbh session return --finish. When the close prints back in: (a parent frame is open), do not return: continue the parent frame.
